backend/main.mo: Motoko actor implementing the backend for QuickRepair: manages user profiles, feedback/ratings, and booking records with role-based access control (admin vs. authenticated user) using AccessControl and MixinAuthorization mixins.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting two implemented features: removing specific Service Timing dropdown options and removing the Live Location Tracking UI from BookingFormSection.tsx and BookingPage.tsx.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON document containing short summaries of each frontend source file, describing their purpose, styling, SEO changes, and component-level functionality across the QuickRepair React app.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base CSS file defining OKLCH-based CSS custom properties for light and dark themes, covering background, foreground, card, sidebar, chart, and other UI color tokens.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the QuickRepair frontend with SEO meta tags, Open Graph/Twitter Card tags, Google site verification, structured LocalBusiness JSON-LD schema, and preconnect hints for ICP and Internet Identity.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React app component that sets up React Query, lazy-loads below-fold sections, and routes between main site, admin, booking, booking history, mechanic registration, and terms pages based on the current pathname.
frontend/src/components/AboutSection.tsx: Renders the 'About Us' section with a two-column layout: a text description of QuickRepair's mission and a grid of four highlight cards (response time, verified professionals, transparent pricing, local coverage) with fade-in animation.
frontend/src/components/AdminPage.tsx: Password-protected admin dashboard that allows managing users, feedback, services (CRUD), and mechanic registrations using React Query hooks, with session persistence via localStorage.
frontend/src/components/BookingFormSecti: Booking form section that requires Internet Identity authentication, auto-fills address from IP geolocation, submits via FormSubmit fetch, and shows a success overlay with sound on completion.
frontend/src/components/BookingSuccessOv: Full-screen portal overlay that displays an animated SVG checkmark circle and 'Booking Confirmed' message, auto-dismissing after 2.8 seconds or on user tap.
frontend/src/components/ContactSection.t: Displays contact information (phone, email, working hours) and a list of service areas in a two-column card layout with fade-in animation.
frontend/src/components/FAQSection.tsx: Accordion-style FAQ section with 11 questions covering response time, pricing, service areas, and policies, using local state to track which item is expanded and a fade-in hook.
Renders a feedback/reviews section with sample and live reviews fetched via React Query hooks, displaying star ratings and allowing authenticated users to submit new feedback.
frontend/src/components/FloatingCallButt: A fixed floating button that links to a phone number (tel:) with a gradient style and 'Call Now' label.
frontend/src/components/FloatingWhatsApp: A fixed floating WhatsApp button with a pulse animation that opens a pre-filled WhatsApp chat link for booking services.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Site footer with logo, smooth-scroll nav links, a 'Book Online' button, copyright notice, and a caffeine.ai attribution link.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Sticky header with logo, scroll-aware background, mobile navigation drawer, and Internet Identity authentication with profile modal support.
frontend/src/components/HeroSection.tsx: Full-screen hero section with animated fade-in content, a background image with overlay, tagline, and CTA buttons for booking and services.
frontend/src/components/HowItWorksSectio: Three-step process section (Book, Arrive, Solved) with icons, connector lines for desktop/mobile, and a fade-in animation on scroll.
frontend/src/components/NavigationDrawer: A slide-in mobile navigation drawer that highlights the active section via scroll spy, shows nav links, and conditionally renders Booking History for authenticated users.
frontend/src/components/Overlay.tsx: A full-screen semi-transparent backdrop overlay used to close the mobile navigation drawer when clicked.
frontend/src/components/ProfileModal.tsx: A modal form that collects a user's name, phone number, and service area, then registers them via the useRegisterUser mutation hook.
frontend/src/components/ServiceCard.tsx: Displays a single repair service with its icon, description, starting price, and a 'Book Online' button that navigates to the booking page.
Renders the services section of the landing page, fetching services from the backend and falling back to hardcoded entries if none are available.
frontend/src/components/TrustStatsBar.ts: A horizontal stats bar displaying key trust indicators (happy customers, response time, star rating) with fade-in animation on scroll.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and caches an ICP backend actor using React Query, initializing it with the user's Internet Identity or anonymously, and invalidates dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useFadeIn.ts: A custom hook that uses IntersectionObserver to set a visibility flag when the referenced element scrolls into view, enabling fade-in animations.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an Internet Identity authentication context with login, logout, and status tracking via DFINITY's AuthClient, exposed through a React context and hook.
frontend/src/hooks/useIpLocation.ts: Custom React hook that fetches the user's location (city, region, country, lat/lon) from the ipapi.co API and returns status, a status message, and the location data.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Centralizes all React Query hooks for the app, including feedback CRUD, user profile management, admin checks, bookings, and mechanic registration, each backed by an ICP actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useScrollSpy.ts: Custom React hook that tracks which section ID is currently in view based on scroll position, returning the active section ID.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet that imports fonts, sets up Tailwind, defines CSS custom properties for theming, and declares custom animations including a GPay-style booking success overlay.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that mounts the React app with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider wrapping the root App component.
frontend/src/pages/BookingHistoryPage.ts: Page that displays a logged-in user's past bookings sorted newest-first, showing service ID, address, phone, date, and time for each booking card.
frontend/src/pages/BookingPage.tsx: Booking form page that auto-fills the address from IP geolocation, submits via FormSubmit, and shows a GPay-style success overlay with sound on completion.
frontend/src/pages/MechanicRegistrationP: Mechanic registration form page with client-side validation that submits applicant details via a mutation hook and displays a GPay-style success overlay on success.
frontend/src/pages/TermsPage.tsx: Renders the QuickRepair Terms and Policies page with sections covering response time, service guarantee, pricing, service area, and customer feedback. Uses a dark-themed layout with a sticky header and card-based policy sections.
frontend/src/utils/playSuccessSound.ts: Provides a utility function that plays a Google Pay-style ascending C-E-G major chord arpeggio using the Web Audio API. Silently fails if the API is unavailable.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility module for extracting, persisting, and clearing URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routes, with sessionStorage fallback support. Includes helpers to store/retrieve/clear session parameters and strip sensitive params from the URL bar.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining custom fonts, brand colors, surface palette, box shadows, border radii, and keyframe animations for the QuickRepair frontend. Includes typography, container-queries, and animate plugins.
project_state.json: Tracks the current state of the QuickRepair project at version 11, documenting completed features (SEO updates, IP-based location detection, form changes) and pending tasks. Serves as a structured changelog and feature registry for the build.
